The hedge fund run by Jeffrey Bronchick held 237 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $195,000, down from 1,260 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cove Street Capital Llc who had been investing in White Mountains Insurance Group for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.83B market cap company.
